frame_rule: frame f of bin b covers [b * bin_seconds + f * frame_seconds, + frame_seconds) seconds since the epoch

grid.align: point — row r is latitude -90 + 10 r, column c is longitude -180 + 10 c (fixture)
grid.coordinates: lon = x0 + (col + 0.5) * dx, lat = y0 + (row + 0.5) * dy

index_semantics: (offset, length): offset >= 0 and length > 0 a stored tile; offset >= 0 and length 0 a present frame's tile with no valid pixel (not stored); offset -1 and length 0 the frame is not in the shard
shard_path: <yyyy>/bin_<NNNN>.zst (yyyy = year of the bin's first day)
